title: Tunguska as a Tesla death weapon
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Tunguska as a Tesla death weapon, about 1908 at Tunguska, Siberia, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: some people have this conspiracy that Tesla the Tangusa 1908 Siberia asteroid impact was actually just a Tesla death weapon

related.note: This is the same 1908 Tunguska event, but it is explained as a Tesla death weapon instead of a natural air burst from the Taurid stream.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions a theory about Tunguska, a huge explosion over Siberia in 1908 that he calls an asteroid impact. He says some people believe it was really a test of a "death weapon" built by the inventor Nikola Tesla, which would mean a man made that blast, not something from space.
